predictions.prediction_text: Market will experience a move up during the week accompanied by heavy volatility selling.
predictions.expected_result: SPX closes the week higher than it opened while implied volatility (VIX or ATM IV on SPX options) falls by at least 5% from the week's open to close.

predictions.prediction_text: Post-OpEx there will be strength and stabilization into the mid-September window.
predictions.expected_result: Over the two weeks following OpEx, SPX exhibits a net gain and intraday realized volatility declines, with fewer daily moves greater than 1.5% compared with the two weeks before OpEx.

predictions.prediction_text: Until SPX can perform 6412 in a weekly average, the market is heading towards equilibrium (i.e., mean/reversion rather than trending away).
predictions.expected_result: While the 7-day (weekly) average of SPX stays below 6412, price action will remain range-bound with no sustained breakout beyond the week's high or low by more than 2%.

predictions.prediction_text: Market’s centroid area (magnet) is 6395.48 - 6384.88 and price will gravitate to that zone.
predictions.expected_result: Within the next five trading days, SPX will trade into the 6384.88–6395.48 range at least once.

predictions.prediction_text: 6435.37 is likely to act as a reversion level back toward the centroid unless CPI is very disinflationary and geo hopes are strong.
predictions.condition: unless CPI prints very disinflationary and geopolitical developments boost risk-on
predictions.expected_result: If CPI is not markedly disinflationary, SPX touching 6435.37 will subsequently move back toward the centroid range (6384.88–6395.48) within three trading days.

predictions.prediction_text: A break above 6435.37 would confirm further upward momentum toward ~6483.50 (benign CPI bet).
predictions.expected_result: If SPX closes above 6435.37, it will continue higher and reach or test 6483.50 within five trading days.

predictions.prediction_text: Downside pivot at 6269.55 serves as the borderline where spot can escape the centroid magnet and move lower toward 6230, though the market places little probability on this.
predictions.expected_result: If SPX closes below 6269.55, it will decline further and test 6230 within three trading days.

predictions.prediction_text: Volatility needs to be sold for the market to stabilize at higher levels; VIX will compress around OpEx.
predictions.expected_result: VIX will decline or remain subdued around OpEx, with VIX spot or ATM IV on indices falling relative to the prior week by at least 10%.

predictions.prediction_text: After OpEx there will be mechanical buyback flow, especially if spot is above the centroid, reinforcing stabilization higher.
predictions.condition: after OpEx and SPX spot is above centroid (6384.88–6395.48)
predictions.expected_result: If post-OpEx SPX is trading above 6395.48, net buying pressure will push SPX further higher within two trading days, producing a positive daily return on majority of those days.
